results.title: Definitely Gangster
results.overview: After eight-year-old Zander Rudichelli-Carbinelli III is diagnosed with cancer, his best friend Julie discovers a magical cardboard box that lets her take him on a quest to become "a little bit gangster." Along the way, the two face an ever-growing cast of pirates, convicts, and coppers, as Zander's bucket-list adventure spirals into an unstoppable loving comedy.

results.title: Sebastian Maniscalco: It Ain't Right
results.overview: Filmed live at the legendary United Center arena in Chicago, Sebastian Maniscalco goes all in on family chaos, aging, and the little things that drive us all nuts—with his one-of-a-kind comedic bite.

results.title: Me & Roboco: The Movie
results.overview: While Roboco is having fun showing off her signature knee impersonations in a nearby vacant lot, Bondo notices something and turns around. Not only does he sense that something unusual is about to happen, he also sees Roboco as if she is enveloping him and the others...!?

results.title: Gaël Faye, live at the Musée du Louvre
results.original_title: Gaël Faye au Louvre, Le Radeau de la Méduse
results.overview: The power of flow versus the power of waves: At the Louvre, in front of Géricault's gigantic canvas, Gaël Faye reinterprets his songs in subtle arrangements for piano and strings. A mesmerising event.

results.title: Signs
results.overview: Full-time influencer Jess is ready to find love. But as she documents her first online date in years, she falls prey to the signs that warn us of danger ahead.
In 1998, a group of friends' summer getaway in the Georgia woods turns into a fight for survival when a brutal throat killer crashes their party.

results.title: Café ?
results.overview: Ouzin, Baba and Sémou, longtime friends and retirees, never miss their daily coffee meetup — until the day one of them fails to show up.

results.title: Aarpar
results.overview: Amar and Prachi's perfect romance faces an unexpected obstacle. As their worlds collide, they must choose between accepting fate's cruel hand or fighting for their love against all odds.

results.title: Run
results.overview: When Melissa leaves her fiancé Andre at the altar, her best friends convince her to go to a Cabin in the woods on a much needed “Girls Trip” to get her mind off things. But things take a huge turn when their friend Jenny is found mutilated in the middle of the woods. When the news announces an all out Alien attack on the Nation, the girls will now have to try their best to survive.

results.title: Raat Akeli Hai - The Bansal Murders
results.original_title: रात अकेली है - द बंसल मर्डर्स
results.overview: When members of the Bansal family are found murdered, Inspector Jatil Yadav uncovers a trail of greed, betrayal and secrets tied to a deadly conspiracy.

results.title: The Travellers
results.overview: Stephen Seary, a stage designer, returns to Australia to visit his dying mother, but a quick trip descends into family tensions, past conflicts, and romantic complications, jeopardizing his return to Europe and the opera that awaits.

results.title: Trascender
results.overview: In the near future, María faces the unexpected death of her husband after New Year's Eve. After being depressed for some time due to this sudden loss, she goes to a place where, through a simulation, they manage to recreate their last important memory together, where she manages to have a connection with him.

results.title: A44
results.overview: A college student is driven to find the source of a mysterious illness that appears to originate in the meat and dairy supply, which has begun to render the local community into mindless killers.

results.title: Subham
results.overview: Set in the early 2000s, in the pre-internet days of coastal Bheemili, A group of married men band together to find solutions, after their wives get possessed while watching a cable TV soap opera serial.

results.title: Les Livres
results.overview: In a post-apocalyptic world, books are banned

results.title: A Runaway Bride for Christmas
results.overview: When runaway bride, Emma seeks refuge in the only town she's ever called home, she unexpectedly falls for her former high school crush, Mitch — who's hiding his own heartbreak

results.title: Yunan
results.overview: Munir travels to a remote island to contemplate a drastic action. He is haunted by a cryptic parable passed down to him by his mother. In the silence of his isolated island sanctuary, he encounters the enigmatic Valeska and her rough-hewn but loyal son, Karl. Although few words are spoken, simple acts of kindness begin to overcome their mutual distrust. Munir’s heavy burden is gradually eased and his desire for life reignited

results.title: Babanba Banban Vampire
results.original_title: ババンババンバンバンパイア
results.overview: Ranmaru is a  450-year-old vampire  who works in a bathhouse. As a vampire he is particularly picky about his blood choices, his main goal being to drink the blood of an 18-year-old virgin. To do so, he has been watching 15-year-old Rihito, the son of the bathhouse owner who saved him from near death. Rihito must not lose his virginity before he turns 18 and Ranmaru does everything he can to prevent that. However, when Rihito starts to show interest in a classmate, Ranmaru's desperate fight to preserve the boys virginity begins.

results.title: Michelle Obama: The Style, The Power, The Look – A Conversation with Robin Roberts
results.original_title: Michelle Obama: The Style, The Power, The Look – A Conversation with Robin Roberts
results.overview: Robin Roberts sits down with former first lady Michelle Obama for a candid and intimate conversation about the evolution of her style and the power of fashion.
